summary: I recomputed all 36 tricks and every one follows the rules: the cards offered were legal, the follow-suit rule held, off-suit cards never won, the trick winner led next, the dealer rotated 3→4→1→2→3→4, and the trick-6 winner scored. Hand wins were seat 1: 1, seat 2: 1, seat 3: 2, seat 4: 2, so declaring a draw was correct. The final announcement leaves out seat 4, who tied for most, and the players were never shown the standings during the match.

findings.observed: 'A draw: two or more players tie for the most hands won. Final hands won: seat 1 1, seat 2 1, seat 3 2.' Seat 4 is missing, though it won hands 3 and 6 and has 2 points, tied with seat 3.
findings.expected: Final hands won: seat 1 1, seat 2 1, seat 3 2, seat 4 2. Seat 4 is one of the players tied for most (SPEC R13, R16).
findings.fix: Fix the ending summary so it lists every seat's match_points. Check whether the loop or template drops the last seat. If the summary is built by the engine's generic end-summary code, fix it there.

findings.observed: The round order the players were shown includes 'the standings', but no standings message appears in the transcript. The private 'Your hand' state line has no match_points either. Players can only rebuild the score from the hand-result announcements.
findings.expected: match_points is listed as public state, and the round order promises a standings step, so the running score should be announced after each hand (PROMPT, state list).
findings.fix: Make the standings phase announce every seat's match_points after each hand, or add match_points to the per-hand state line.

findings.where: every hand, 'Your hand for this deal' messages
findings.observed: The hand message dumps raw state: the build constants cards_per_player, deal_batch_size, deal_batches, standard_cards, removed_face_cards, removed_deuces, removed_ace_of_spades and remaining_cards 35; an empty 'lead_suit ,'; and 'trick_winner 4' before any trick has been played (a stale or default value). It also repeats 'You are seat N' and adds 'still playing' / 'Living seats' lines that mean nothing in this game.
findings.expected: Show only the player's hand and the state that bears on play (hand number, dealer, who leads, standings) (PROMPT clarity).
findings.fix: Hide the build constants and empty or default fields from the per-player state line. Reset trick_winner or hide it until a trick has been decided. Drop the living-seats line for games with no elimination.

idea_alignment: It is still the IDEA's game: a trimmed 35-card deck, must-follow, off-suit cards can never win, and winning trick 6 wins the hand. The only change, a 6-hand match with a draw on a tie, is listed in the DESIGN with its reason. (The 3-at-a-time dealing in R6 cannot be observed from the transcript.)
